newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cimescaut H1 group pre-tax plunges. [corrected 11:01 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Cimescaut H1 group pre-tax plunges. [corrected 11:01 gmt]

text.p: (in millions of Belgian francs unless stated)
NOTE - Cimescaut SA is a Belgian producer of cement and limestone which exploits stone pits. Belgian cement maker CBR owns about one third of Cimescaut's capital.
(Corrects to delete reference to Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA. SGB's involvement in Cimescaut ended in 1993.)

Cimescaut said that in view of the termination of a contract for ballast for the Belgian high-speed train line and a lack of signs of an economic improvement second half profit would be below second half 1995 pre-tax profit of 36.52 million francs.
